newsitem.title: DUBAI: UAE banks should merge - minister.
newsitem.headline: UAE banks should merge - minister.

text.p: To meet the requirements of a fast- developing economy, banks in the United Arab Emirates should merge, Minister of State for Finance and Industrial Affairs Ahmed bin Humaid al-Tayer said on Saturday.

"To benefit from future opportunities and to be able to face its financing requirements, the financial sector should...get more resources and this will require creating large banking units by mergers," he said.

This would better enable them to meet the needs of the UAE, which has seen gross domestic product expand to 144 billion dirhams ($39 billion) in 1995 from 40 billion dirhams in 1975, he told the opening of the annual Emirates International Forum.
Bankers have said the Gulf banking sector is congested and the region's over 100 indigenous banks need to merge to boost their capital bases to compete with international banks.
There are 27 foreign banks, 15 representative offices and 19 local banks operating in the UAE.
